title: 技術者基礎
subtitle: Basics for Engineers
keywords: Academic Field 2.Recommended Subjects in the Specialized Field 3.Course Selection 4.Study / Registration Plan 5.Logical Writing
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) understand "Academic Field" of the two courses in the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering. (2) understand the specialized subject groups in each field, which start from 3rd term. (3) understand outlines of the subject group to determine the specialized field. (4) summarize study and registration plans using logical sentences.
advice: This is a career design course to clarify future field of student and the image of electrical / electronic engineers and researchers. Students will understand what to learn from now on, and make study and registration plans using logical sentences. 1. Self-analysis and career design Students will investigate technical trends and industry/corporate with relation to electric and electronic engineering, and set goals for higher education/employment. 2. Understanding specialized fields and required subjects in the course (compulsory subject) Through classes and surveys, students will understand outlines of specialized fields and required subjects (compulsory subjects) for electrical engineering course and electronic engineering course. In addition, students will understand the relationship between laboratories in Design project III and the required subjects of each course. 3. Determination of course and making study/registration plans Students will determine their course and clarify their learning objectives. After that, students will summarize their study/registration plans from 4th term.
requiredKnowledge: (1) Students should actively ask questions and deepen their understanding. (2) Students are encouraged to take specialized subjects so as to take into account their future design. (3) It is important to read the textbooks used for each subject on a daily basis and to try to understand the context by remembering the meaning of the technical terms in the subject.

activityGoals.body: Be able to investigate trends in technology related to electrical and electronic engineering.
Be able to explain the specialized fields and required subjects of the two courses, as well as their necessity
Be able to clearly explain your learning goals after 4th term.
Be able to plan study/registration schedule after 4th term.
Be able to express yourself thoughts as a logical and clear statement.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the overall situation in each of the broad fields of electrical and electronic engineering. (2) Assuming that you have worked or become an expert in that field in the future, think about what you can do with your aptitude and draw objective visions in various technical fields. (3) In order to become an active electrical and electronic engineer, fully understand what you need to learn at the university, make study and registration plans for acquisition, and express compelling, logical and clear sentences.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the situation in each of the broad fields of electrical and electronic engineering. (2) Assuming that you have worked or become an expert in that field in the future, think about what you can do with your aptitude and draw objective visions in various technical fields. (3) In order to become an active electrical and electronic engineer, understand what you need to learn at the university, make study and registration plans for acquisition, and express these sentences.

lessons.content: Self-analysis and career design 1 Outline of industry and companies related to electrical and electronic engineering and major employment opportunities for students
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Browse website of the Career Placement Center. Review: Survey of related technical trends and industry / company.

lessons.assignments: Preparation: Consider self-analysis and career design Review: Set on your goals for suitable higher education / employment.

lessons.content: Specialized fields and required subjects 1 Outlines on specialized fields (learning fields) and required subjects in the two courses of the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, qualifications, etc. Return reports and comments
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the related pages in the curriculum guidebook. Review: Check the lecture, and the difference with two courses.

lessons.content: Specialized fields and required subjects 2 Writing "Report related with specialized fields and required subjects" and submission
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Check the format of "Report related with specialized fields and required subjects." Review: Complete the previous report.

lessons.content: Course selection and study/registration plans 1 Understand what you need to learn, select a course in two courses. Write "study and registration plan 1" and " study and registration plan 2."
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Check the report formats. Review: Determine the course what you want, make drafts of the plan completely.

lessons.content: Self-check (class), return reports, feedback, and study/registration plans 2 Check your "study and registration plan 1" and "study and registration plan 2." After the check, submission the two plans. Implementation of questionnaire.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read your drafts of the plan. Review: Complete "study and registration plan 1" and "study and registration plan 2 ", and submit them. Preparation 60 Review 180
